record_title: A persistent idempotent in every Dunford–Pettis power ideal on L1
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result does not prove that the Dunford–Pettis power ideals are pairwise distinct. The originality claim is the synthesis of Acuaviva's new non-RNP Schur projection with Nasseri's new power-ideal framework. The full text of Saab's 1982 paper was not inspected; its accessible abstract is related to the classical representability/RNP ingredient but predates the 2026 constructions.
